privacyBody:
{site} respects your privacy. This page explains what we collect when you use this site and why.

## What we collect
When you visit, we record your IP address, the page you opened and your browser type in our visit logs. We keep these logs for 90 days to keep the site secure and understand how it is used.

## Accounts
If you sign up, our sign-in provider stores your name and email address so you can log in. You can ask us to delete your account at any time.

## Course reminders
If you ask for a reminder, we keep your email address and the course you chose only until the reminder is sent, you cancel it, or the course starts. Then we delete it.

## Your city
You can choose a city to see courses near it. We remember your choice in a cookie on your browser. We do not try to work out where you are.

## Cookies
We use only the cookies needed to remember your language, city, distance, cookie notice and sign-in. We use no advertising or tracking cookies.

## Registration
Course registration and payment happen on the Art of Living registration site, which has its own privacy policy.

## Contact
Questions about your privacy? Contact {contact}.
termsBody:
These terms apply to your use of the {site} website.

## Use of this site
This site lists Art of Living courses in and around {city} for your information. Please use it lawfully and do not try to disrupt it.

## Course information
Course details come from the Art of Living course system. We try to keep them accurate, but dates, venues, teachers and prices can change. Please check the details when you register.

## Registration and payment
Registration and payment are handled on the external Art of Living registration site under its own terms.

## No warranty
This site is provided as is, without warranties of any kind. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any loss arising from your use of the site.

## Changes
We may update these terms from time to time. The current version is always on this page.

## Contact
Questions about these terms? Contact {contact}.

giftNextSteps:
Contact the person personally, and tell them you are sending them an email with a gift code for an Art of Living course.
Forward the email with the code to that person.
If they are not interested in the gift, you may choose another person and send the gift to them instead.
Once the email is sent, anyone with the code can use it. Keep it private until you have given it to the right person.
The code can be used more than once until its full amount is used. Each time it is used, you will get an email with the course and the remaining balance.
